xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: An order has been issued levying IGST of ₹2,89,48,311 and an IGST penalty of ₹28,94,883 under Section 73(1) of the CGST Act, 2017 for FY 2021–22 in respect of the factory operating within the Special Economic Zone. The Company is in the process of filing an appeal on or before 15th March 2026 under Section 107 of the CGST Act, 2017, along with the statutory pre-deposit of 10% of the disputed tax.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: An order has been issued determining a differential IGST liability based on variances between the E way Bill and GSTR 3B, treating the difference as ‘unpaid tax’.
